Incident and correction, recorded: spawning lane agents with harness worktree isolation set core.bare=true on the PRIMARY checkout git config, which made git refuse every work-tree operation there. Caught immediately by a failing supervisor commit; core.bare unset, HEAD 692f57c and index intact, nothing lost. Root cause: double isolation - loop-prompt-lane.md section 1.1 already has every lane create its own short-path worktree under C:/w/, so harness-level isolation was redundant and its bookkeeping flipped the parent repo bare. Correction: spawn lane agents WITHOUT harness worktree isolation and let the lane prompt create its own, exactly as lanes B/C/D did on 2026-09-06. If any agent in the primary checkout hits a work-tree fatal, the fix is: git config --unset core.bare - a config flag, never repository damage.
